name: Bellglass Chorus
description: Echo the opening reaction, conduct its order, and earn bonuses for Infusion → Browning or Browning → Extraction.

residues.name: Tuned Rim
residues.text: Every echo costs 0.08 / 0.05 presence instead of 0.10.

residues.name: Silver Note
residues.text: When 3 distinct common reactions score, add +100% / +200% of the opening pulse to its echo.

objective.text: Score 3 distinct common reactions in 3 servings.

residues.name: Counterpoint
residues.text: Harmony and Crescendo copies gain ×1.5 / ×2.5 points. Both still require their specific reaction order.

objective.text: Trigger Harmony or Crescendo 3 times in total.

residues.name: Encore
residues.text: With an operational echo source and 3 positive common reactions, copy 35% / 65% of the LAST common reaction as an extra derived pulse. No extra presence cost; cannot echo again.

objective.text: Score 3 distinct common reactions in 4 servings.

cards.name: Glass Noodle
cards.text: At any heat, copies 125% of the first positive, echoable original reaction onto its scored ingredients. Costs 0.10 presence each serving (0.08 / 0.05 / 0.02 with Tuned Rim). Takes priority over Bell Herb. Derived echoes and sequence bonuses never echo again.

cards.name: Bell Herb
cards.text: Copies 75% of the first positive, echoable original reaction for 0.10 presence (less with Tuned Rim). Glass Noodle takes priority. Conductors choose the opener; Aromatic pairs with Fat for Infusion at 40–100°C.

cards.name: Chime Fruit
cards.text: Conductor: moves Browning to the front, or Preservation at 0–60°C. If several conductors are present, the oldest active one leads. Browning before Extraction unlocks Resonant Marrow’s Crescendo. Requires at least 0.25 presence to conduct.

cards.name: Silver Cream
cards.text: Conductor: moves Infusion to the front. Oldest active conductor wins. Fat 2 + Aromatic enables Infusion at 40–100°C; with Quiet Mushroom, following it with Browning unlocks Harmony. Replace an older conductor to change the lead.

cards.name: Resonant Marrow
cards.text: Crescendo: at 70–110°C, when Browning scores before Extraction in the same serving, add a derived copy of Extraction worth 100% × this Marrow’s presence. Only the oldest operational Marrow triggers. Protein 2 enables Browning; reversing the order gives no Crescendo.

cards.name: Quiet Mushroom
cards.text: Harmony: at 70–100°C, when Infusion scores before Browning in the same serving, add a derived copy of Browning worth 100% × this Mushroom’s presence. Only the oldest operational Mushroom triggers. Silver Cream can conduct Infusion first; reversed order gives no Harmony.

cards.name: Clear Gel
cards.text: At 40–60°C, the oldest echo source retains at least 96% after serving. Echo presence costs still apply first. Mineral enables Extraction with Acid at 50–120°C, helping complete a three-reaction Silver Note serving.

cards.name: Crystal Citrus
cards.text: Conductor: moves Extraction to the front (Acid + Mineral at 50–120°C). Oldest active conductor wins. Use it to echo a strong Extraction, but leading Extraction prevents Browning → Extraction Crescendo unless an older conductor leads Browning.
